title: The geometry at half, one, two and four bodies of overlap
caption: One sweep from the sacrum at each overlap with the step exactly as commanded: the frames, and each body coloured by how many frames hold it. At half a body a body falls between frames; at one most bodies are seen once; at two most are seen twice; at four the sweep takes eleven exposures.

source.notes: Drawn by the simulation's own geometry (field 140 mm, pitches 34 and 27 mm, the in-frame rule of sweep_map.py), not by hand.
